title: Pão de Queijo
summary: Crisp outside, chewy and cheesy inside: Brazilian cheese bread made with a scalded tapioca-starch dough. The dough freezes well, so you can bake a handful at a time.

ingredient_groups.name: Dough
items: 200 g grated Parmesan or Minas cheese

method_sections.name: Make the dough
steps: Bring the milk, oil and salt to a boil.
Pour it over the tapioca starch and mix with a spoon until it forms a lumpy, scalded dough. Let it cool for 10 minutes.
Add the eggs one at a time, kneading until smooth, then knead in the cheese.

method_sections.name: Shape & bake
steps: With oiled hands, roll the dough into balls about 3 cm across and set them on a lined tray.
Bake at 200°C (390°F) for about 25 minutes, until puffed and golden.

title: Lemon Olive Oil Cake
tagline: Lemon zest · olive oil · one bowl
summary: A tender, fragrant loaf that keeps for days. Everything is whisked in one bowl, and a quick lemon syrup soaks in while it is still warm.

method_sections.name: Cake
steps: Rub the lemon zest into the sugar with your fingers until fragrant.
Whisk in the eggs, then the olive oil and yogurt.
Fold in the flour, baking powder and salt until just combined.
Pour into a lined loaf pan and bake at 175°C (350°F) for about 50 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.

method_sections.name: Syrup
steps: Warm the lemon juice and sugar until the sugar dissolves.
Poke holes in the warm cake and spoon the syrup over it. Cool in the pan.
